name: octal-games
description: Kayles, Dawson's Kayles and any octal game in the browser against a perfect Sprague–Grundy player, plus the period of every octal game with at most three digits recomputed, proved with the Guy–Smith theorem and checked against Flammenkamp's tables. TypeScript, no runtime deps.

scripts.table: node tools/run-jobs.mts runs/jobs-standard.txt runs/standard.jsonl 4 && node tools/run-jobs.mts runs/jobs-solved.txt runs/solved.jsonl 6 && node tools/build-table.mts
